name: Domnall Ilchelgach
text: Domnall Ilchelgach is the Irish phrase for of the many treacheries. MacKillop styles him a historical Irish high king, ard ri, who died in 566. He was a son of Muirchertach mac Erca. Through him he was an ancestor of the Ui Néill and the MacLoughlin families. The Domnall of so many treacheries was a marker of the fragmented politics of mid-sixth-century Ireland. His epithet names the conditions of his reign rather than any single deed.

okr.objective: Domnall Ilchelgach as the mid-sixth-century Ui Néill high king of many treacheries.
